subject: Stakeholder map, procurement checkpoints & MAP — next steps
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@clearwellhealth.com>, Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Dan Webb <dan.webb@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder map, procurement checkpoints & MAP — next steps

Hi Elena / Priyanka — great speaking with you today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Economic buyer: believed to be Dan Webb (CFO) — needs finance/ROI sign-off
- Security lead / technical reviewer: Priyanka Shah
- Procurement & legal: procurement@clearwellhealth.com + in-house counsel (TBD)
- POC goals: validate latency at 95th percentile < 120ms for anonymized 1k QPS workload; measure per-token cost with batch config; evaluate response quality on the 10 core intent prompts we shared

Proposed MAP (high level) — attached draft-MAP.xlsx
1) Week 1 (Apr 12–16): Security questionnaire + SOC2 overview delivered by us; information request checklist from your side
2) Week 3 (Apr 26–30): POC kickoff (2-week lab POC) — Redwood to provide test harness and baseline config
3) Week 6 (May 17–21): POC readout and ROI sketch with preliminary pricing
4) Week 8–10 (late May–Jun): Procurement & legal review, contract redlines; target execution by end of quarter if all aligns

Asks / confirmations needed from ClearWell
- Confirm economic buyer is Dan Webb and that he expects a single ROI package (yes/no)
- Confirm procurement timeline (target month for contract signature)
- Confirm required security artifacts (SOC2 report, network architecture diagram, KMS/SSO requirements)
- Any hard constraints on pilot data residency or on-prem needs?

Attachments: [Attachment: draft-MAP.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)], [Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf, 220KB)]

I'll follow up with an internal note to align pricing and legal on our side and share an updated MAP by Wednesday. Can we tentatively hold May 17–21 for the POC readout?

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Subject: Re: Stakeholder map, procurement checkpoints & MAP — next steps

Thanks Rachel — useful recap. Confirming a few items: 

- Dan Webb is the economic buyer; he'll want a short ROI one-pager (we can share our template).
- Priyanka is the security reviewer and will own the questionnaire. She already asked for a SOC2 type II summary and a network diagram (please send).
- Procurement will own contract cadence; internal target has procurement review in mid-May and signature late May, but we may need to nudge that earlier depending on budget cycles. Their inbox is procurement@clearwellhealth.com.
- Data residency: POC will use anonymized cloud-hosted test data; production decision TBD but must be able to support a VPC option.

Question for Redwood: do you have a standard DPA + SOC2 attestation we can review now? Also please include a short commercial sketch (ballpark monthly cost ranges) so Dan can evaluate.

Appreciate you picking up calendar slots; May 17–21 works for a readout — we prefer May 19 as a target.

Elena
VP, Strategy & Partnerships
ClearWell Health
elena@clearwellhealth.com

Markus / Marissa — forwarding the confirmed stakeholders and timeline from ClearWell. Quick requests so we can get an updated MAP to them by EOD Wednesday: 

Markus: can you prepare a 1-page commercial sketch with two options (hosted pay-as-you-go and 12-month reserved) and ballpark ARR impact? They asked for "ballpark monthly cost ranges" for Dan. Put pricing in ranges and include assumptions (QPS, token counts, P95 latency target).

Marissa: Priyanka wants SOC2 and network architecture upfront. Can you assemble the SOC2 summary + short answers to common procurement questions (SSO/SAML support, KMS options, audit logs retention) and drop into the shared MAP?

I'll consolidate and send the updated MAP + calendar invites for the POC kickoff and May 19 readout.

Attachments: [Attachment: outline-MAP.xlsx (xlsx, 16KB)]

Thanks — rachel

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@clearwellhealth.com>, Priyanka Shah <priyanka.shah@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Stakeholder map, procurement checkpoints & MAP — commercial + security asks

Rachel — on it. High-level commercial sketch attached and main assumptions below.

Commercial sketch (summary)
- Option A: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) — expected range $8k–$15k/month during a 2-week POC depending on token consumption; production estimate varies by traffic
- Option B: Dedicated reserved (12-month) — baseline $60k–$80k/month for a 4-GPU pool with committed throughput; significant unit-cost improvements at scale
- Typical discounting: 10–25% on committed terms depending on term length and minimum spend

Assumptions: 1k QPS simulated during POC (bursty), 95th pct latency target 120ms on small prompt set, caching & batching optimizations enabled.

Deliverables I will attach: commercial-sketch.pdf (ballpark tables), example contract terms we commonly put in early drafts.

I flagged the need to preserve an "escape" clause for pilot data if they require additional controls; that will be part of the DPA conversation.

Markus
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: commercial-sketch.pdf (pdf, 84KB)]
